hero.description: Krishi Sanyog empowers farmers with real-time soil health diagnostics, personalized fertilizer recommendations, crop suitability modeling, and hyper-local weather advisories.

features.title: Built for Modern & Sustainable Farming
features.subtitle: Everything you need to optimize crop yields, lower input costs, and access government support.
features.fertilizerDesc: Get precise N-P-K nutrient dosage customized to your land size, soil test values, and targeted crop.
features.cropDesc: Discover high-yield crops suitable for your soil pH, moisture level, temperature, and seasonal market demand.
features.soilDesc: Complete soil quality scoring, organic carbon estimation, and corrective measures for optimal fertility.
features.weatherDesc: Real-time rainfall forecasts, wind speed monitoring, frost warnings, and crop-specific daily advisories.
features.schemesDesc: Browse, check eligibility, and apply directly for subsidies, crop insurance, and financial grants.
features.noticesDesc: Stay informed with instant updates on pest outbreaks, Mandi prices, expert advisories, and weather advisories.

howItWorks.title: How Krishi Sanyog Works
howItWorks.step1Desc: Upload your soil lab report or enter N-P-K, pH, and moisture parameters into our simple form.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Our agricultural neural engine processes your data against soil databases and crop requirements.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Receive instant fertilizer dosage calculations, crop suggestions, and downloadable advisory reports.
